title: Uri's shouts · into the tower, up it and onto the top without stopping
description: La torre de Uri (docs/quests/nuria.md § The tower): every time Uri speaks from the top of Vertitrón it is a jagged violet shout bubble (#shout-bubble, story effect `shout`) and the game goes on: going in (¡NIVEL UNO!), up out of each ring while the party keeps climbing, and onto the platform, where he calls for his boss a moment before the fight comes in. Over his head when he is in sight; from lower down, where he is above the screen, it hangs from the top edge with its tail pointing up at him.

steps.caption: Through the bubble: «¡NIVEL UNO!…» from the top of the tower, no conversation, they can walk straight on
Walking up out of the second ring: Uri's «¡Nivel tres! ¡El último!» pops up and Gerard keeps walking, no dialogue, no halt
